summary: A May 1937 newspaper item says a prison-farm site at Raiford was obtained for a fire tower; lists name a Raiford Lookout Tower, but its build is unconfirmed.

events.note: Site on Florida State Prison Farm land approved for a fire tower, per a May 1937 newspaper item; the sources do not confirm construction

evidence.supports: Newspaper credited as The Florida Times-Union
A site for a fire tower in Union County was obtained
evidence.quote: A site for a fire tower in Union County, has been obtained by Representative Hewitt of Union County.

evidence.supports: State Board of Institutions donated 10 acres of prison farm land
evidence.quote: the State Board of Institutions yesterday donated 10 acres of the Florida State Prison Farm land
The site was approved at a meeting of the board yesterday.

evidence.supports: Tower to be erected on the west side of the farm on State Road 48
evidence.quote: The tower will be erected on the west side of the farm on State Road No. 48.

evidence.supports: Forest work was given nursery space at Raiford Prison to test some 21 species
evidence.quote: We were given nursery space at Raiford Prison to test some 21 species.

evidence.supports: Photo caption places a Raiford seedbed in 1929, before the 1937 item (supports 'before this')
Forest Service reforestation program with pine seedlings began in 1929
evidence.quote: began a reforestation program producing pine seedlings

evidence.supports: 22 lookout towers by 1932, pole lookouts 45 to 70 feet high
evidence.quote: By 1932 there were 22 lookout towers and 9 crows nest which were pole lookouts 45 to 70 feet high.

evidence.supports: Lookouts were manned part time by cooperators and Forest Service crews
evidence.quote: They were manned part time by cooperators and FFS crews.

evidence.supports: Tower list names a Raiford Lookout Tower in Union County
Topo Zone lists the Raiford Lookout Tower in Union County
evidence.quote: Raiford Lookout Tower is listed in the Towers Category for Union County in the state of Florida.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Eastern US Lookouts page heads the item May 24, 1937, and the dateline reads Tallahassee, May 20. Both give 1937, so the event is dated to 1937.

notes_for_editor: Built status not confirmed. The only dated source is a May 1937 newspaper item reprinted on the Eastern US Lookouts page: a site was obtained, land was donated, and the tower was to be erected on the west side of the prison farm on State Road No. 48. No source found says the tower was finished, and none ties the 1937 plan to the Raiford Lookout Tower named on the 2016 Florida list and on Topo Zone. Both list points sit close to the record point: tnlandforms about 28 m away, Topo Zone about 17 m away, so the record location holds. The clipping's dateline is May 20 and its heading reads May 24, 1937. The clipping reads 'for the sale', probably an OCR error for 'site'; the story does not rely on that phrase. The Chronicling America search, Florida Memory item 326330 and the Anyplace America Raiford topo page all returned 403, so the original Times-Union page and any later news of the tower were not checked. The Scribd booklet's 1932 tower count is not tied to Raiford, and the text does not say it is statewide, so the story says only 'by 1932'. The booklet's Raiford seedbed captions (1929 to 1932) and its 1929 reforestation sentence back the 'before this' claim. Record status unknown; no correction proposed.
